title: Satisfaction under restriction to participating variables
statement: Let $P$ be a raw constraint satisfaction instance over a domain $D$, with a finite family of allowed predicates. For any constraint of $P$ and any assignment to all variables, the constraint's satisfaction indicator is the same when the constraint is viewed on the participating variables and the assignment is restricted to those variables.
hypotheses_covered: An assignment to all variables is given
The allowed predicate family is finite (part of the constraint template)
